approved: The Treasury Laws Amendment (GST Integrity) Bill 2017, announced by Minister Kelly O'Dwyer on 31 March 2017 and applying from 1 April 2017, requires purchasers of gold, silver and platinum supplied as taxable supplies to remit GST to the ATO via a reverse charge. The bill also clarifies that precious metals are not second-hand goods, targeting tax avoidance and fraud while securing additional funding for states and territories.
